title: T1134.001 — Access Token Manipulation - Token Impersonation/Theft
subtitle: Press Play to watch a simple model of the technique.
aria: Animated diagram: an attacker program running as a normal user finds an administrator process, copies its access token, and starts a new program that runs as the administrator.
